item.title: Karol G’s New Album ‘No Me Arrepiento de Sentir Tanto’ Featuring Drake & More Is Here: Stream It Now
item.description:
Here's a short, engaging podcast script based on the article:
[Upbeat music fades out, and the host speaks]
Host: "Welcome back to Trending on Billboard! This week, we're talking about the highly anticipated new album from Karol G, 'No Me Arrepiento de Sentir Tanto', which dropped on Friday, August 7th. The 14-track set is a departure from her previous work, with a more intimate and stripped-down sound.
[Soft music plays in the background]
Host: "The album features some amazing collaborations, including Drake on 'Ahí', Bruno Mars on 'Still', and Judeline and Rusowsky on 'Bby Wow'. And if you're a fan of Karol G, you might have already heard some of the singles, like 'Después de Ti' with Cigarettes After Sex guitarist Greg Gonzalez, and 'Matadora', which debuted at number 3 on the Billboard Hot Latin Songs chart.
[Music transitions to a clip of Karol G speaking]
Host: "Karol G wants you to experience this new album in a special way. As she told Elle, 'I want people to listen to this new album that's coming, in their own rooms, and see what comes up for them.' She's inviting everyone to be a little more dramatic, a little more extra, and to feel all the emotions.
[Music transitions back to the host]
Host: "Karol G has been working hard on this project, and she even teased the new album during her concert in Toronto on July 29th. And now, the wait is over. You can stream 'No Me Arrepiento de Sentir Tanto' right now. We'll have a link in our show notes, so be sure to check it out. Thanks for tuning in to Trending on Billboard, and we'll catch you in the next episode!"
[Upbeat music fades back in]
